summary: Phase 3 Media Sound Selector — Frontend E2E verified end-to-end on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) with founder stealth/Password1$. All 10 review checkpoints pass: (1) Feed video composer stages /tmp/test_with_audio.mp4 via feed-composer-video-upload-file-input; AUDIO RIGHTS panel renders with 'Publish Muted' checked by default. (2) Selecting 'Replace with an OurRealm Sound' radio opens feed-composer-video-upload-sound-picker. (3) 7 rows render: 'Neon Realm Groove' (d22ef302256a4652a34d348a3dc65194) badge='Available for OurRealm Reuse' with Select enabled; all 6 other tracks badge='Playable Only' with Select disabled. Rows show cover/title/creator/duration/category. (4) Search 'Neon' filters to 1 row; category chips Music/Podcast/FX + sort trending/newest + tabs Browse/Saved/My Sounds/Recently Used all switch results without errors (Saved=empty, Mine=1, Recent=empty, Browse=1). (5) Selecting the eligible sound opens feed-composer-video-upload-sound-editor with start/duration/fade-in/fade-out/volume/preview/replace/remove sub-controls; feed-composer-video-upload-confirm-upload button visible on screen. (6) Upload video → derivative processing → audio-note reads 'Published with "Neon Realm Groove" replacing the original audio.' Clicking SHARE publishes; new post appears with attribution chip [data-testid=feed-post-sound-<postId>] text '♪ Neon Realm Groove — @stealth'. (7) IMAGE flow: album-picker slot uploads /tmp/img_test.png, feed-composer-add-image-sound button appears, feed-image-sound-picker opens, eligible sound selected, feed-composer-image-sound-editor renders WITH Loop checkbox (image mode); SHARE publishes image post with sound chip + play toggle button. (8) Silent publish keeps default 'Publish Muted', uploads fine, audio-note 'Published with the original audio muted.', SHARE publishes without any sound attribution chip. (9) Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollW=clientW=390), picker inner surface height ≈ 78vh (658px), Upload video button + SHARE button both reachable/visible. (10) Regression: plain Thought post publishes cleanly; only expected 401/404 console noise from pre-existing auth-guarded probes (0 non-expected errors).

ui_bugs.issue: Published videos (both sound-replaced derivative AND default-muted original) render 'Video failed to load' error banner in the feed card. Reproduces for freshly-created video posts. Sound attribution chip and post metadata render correctly; only the <video> element fails. Likely pre-existing playback URL / MIME issue unrelated to Phase 3 selector wiring, but flagging because it directly affects the composer→post user journey demoed here.

issues: Inner bottom-sheet is correctly capped at max-height:78vh (~658px) and no horizontal overflow, but the outer fixed inset-0 overlay's getBoundingClientRect reports height=978px extending below the viewport — cosmetic only (screenshot confirms picker is fully usable & Upload button reachable). Likely a CSS transform on an ancestor breaking fixed positioning coordinates; not blocking.

action_items: Investigate 'Video failed to load' banner on newly-published video posts in FeedCard — check absoluteImageUrl() / video element src resolution for /api/videos/... derivative paths and returned MIME type. Both replace-audio and mute paths reproduce it, so it's likely a rendering-side URL / streaming issue, not composer logic.
critical_code_review_comments: SoundAttachPicker: `s.reuse_badge` text is rendered raw and styled via CSS uppercase — displayed text is 'Playable Only' / 'Available for OurRealm Reuse'. The review spec expected 'PLAYABLE ONLY' / 'AVAILABLE FOR OURREALM REUSE' — visually it matches (uppercase tracking-wider CSS class does the transform), but if you assert on innerText it will not be all-caps. Either update the copy strings or make the reviewer aware.

VideoUploadPicker replace flow silently swallows /videos/{id}/replace-audio errors via try/finally with no catch — if ffmpeg processing fails, next stays the original muted URL and audioNote doesn't mention the sound. Consider surfacing a friendly error toast when the derivative fails.
Feed console emits ~10-12 401/404 errors per page render (pre-existing per iter 89 & 88) — still not cleaned up; makes real errors hard to isolate.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 real posts under stealth via the composer during E2E: (a) video with Neon Realm Groove replacement, (b) muted-original video, (c) image + Neon Realm Groove sound, (d) plain regression thought. These are live in the feed and can be deleted by main agent if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 Sound Selector wiring is solid across desktop + mobile. If retesting: use stealth/Password1$, video composer type = 'feed-composer-type-video', picker testid prefix = 'feed-composer-video-upload-sound-picker', editor prefix = 'feed-composer-video-upload-sound-editor'. Image side uses 'feed-image-sound-picker' + 'feed-composer-image-sound-editor'. Bottom-nav intercepts force-clicks near y>800 — use page.evaluate('...click()') on radios/selects. The eligible demo sound is track d22ef302256a4652a34d348a3dc65194 owned by stealth. Only known caveat: freshly-uploaded videos render 'Video failed to load' in FeedCard — verify separately if video playback needs to work.
rca of the issue: Video-failed-to-load in feed: /api/videos/<id>-derived MP4 URL returned by /videos/upload + /videos/{id}/replace-audio is rendered via absoluteImageUrl(). Either the derivative file isn't served with a video/* content-type, or streaming range requests are rejected on the preview host. Backend health is out of scope for this run; recommend main agent curl the video_url from the new post to verify status/content-type.
